Name: Aba's Universal Loves Begone
Author: Abagaianye
Description:
[b][u][size=5]About The Mod[/size][/u][/b]
Let your gift-giving become more personalised by removing the lists of Universal Love and/or Universal Like gift tastes from your game. This mod will run after all other mods in your mod list and set the Universal Love/Like lists to empty, meaning that NPCs will only rely on their own individual Love and Like lists to determine their gift tastes.

Alternatively, if you are happy with vanilla's universal tastes but just want to get rid of all the extra items that other mods add to those universal tastes, you can set either of them to "Vanilla" instead.

[color=#38761d][size=4]NOTE: Does not affect Stardrop Tea![/size][/color]

[b][u][size=5]Installation[/size][/u][/b]
[i][u]Mod Manager ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]) - Vortex is not recommended[/u][/i]
[list]
[*]Click the "Mod manager download" button on the files page or the "Vortex" button at the top of any page.[/*]
[/list][i][u]Manual[/u][/i]
[list]
[*]Click the "Manual download" button to download the zip file.[/*]
[*]Open the zip file and drag the "[CP] Aba'sUniversalLovesBegone" folder to your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]If you use the Windows right-click->"Extract All..." method to unzip, make sure you don't end up with nested mod folders.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u][size=5]Config[/size][/u][/b]
[i][u]Universal Loves Changes - can be changed at any time in game[/u][/i]
[list]
[*]Remove - remove [b][i]all[/i][/b] items from the Universal Love gift tastes.[/*]
[*]Unchanged - leave Universal Love gift tastes as they are, effectively turning this mod off for them.[/*]
[*]Vanilla - reset Universal Love gift tastes to vanilla only (i.e., will only remove mod-added Universal Love gift tastes).[/*]
[/list][i][u]Universal Likes Changes - can be changed at any time in game[/u][/i]
[list]
[*]Remove - remove [b][i]all[/i][/b] items from the Universal Like gift tastes.[/*]
[*]Unchanged - leave Universal Like gift tastes as they are, effectively turning this mod off for them.[/*]
[*]Vanilla - reset Universal Like gift tastes to vanilla only (i.e., will only remove mod-added Universal Like gift tastes).[/*]
[/list]
[u][b][size=5]Accessibility[/size][/b][/u]
[b][u]Vision[/u][/b]
    [u][i]Stardew Access[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16205]Stardew Access[/url]. It makes no changes to anything visual.[/*]
[/list]    [u][i]Trypophobia[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod is trypophobia safe. It makes no changes to anything visual.[/*]
[/list][b][u]Sound[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]There are no sounds added or edited by this mod.[/*]
[/list]Please contact me if there are accessibility changes I can add for you.

[u][b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44436]Android SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43278]Cinderbox[/url] for mobile.[/*]
[*]Works on mod-added universal gift tastes - please remember that the purpose of this mod is to [b][i]remove[/i][/b] those gift tastes.[/*]
[*]In my opinion, this mod pairs well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24389]Difficulty Socializing[/url], which lets you adjust the friendship gain for talking to and/or gifting NPCs - I have mine set to reduce the friendship point gain from gifting and increase it from talking.[/*]
[*]Another mod that pairs well with this one is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17974]Birthday Knowledge Friendship[/url], which hides NPC birthdays on the calendar until you have a certain heart level with them (default 4, I set mine to 2).[/*]
[/list]
[u][b][size=5]Multiplayer[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Compatible with multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Ensure all players are using the same config settings to avoid bugs.[/*]
[/list]
[u][b][size=5]Uninstallation[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Changes made by this mod are not permanent - they will revert as soon as you disable or delete the mod.[/*]
[*]You can safely uninstall this mod at any time - simply delete the mod folder.[/*]
[/list]
[u][b][size=5]Credits/Thanks[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Thanks to my mates in SMC for encouraging me to actually publish this mod and also for complimenting my thumbnail image art. Graphic design is my passion xD[/*]
[*]Screenshots in this mod are taken in my real playthrough list - if you are curious about what mod anything from my screenshots comes from, please feel free to leave a comment asking about it.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley's[/url] Chinese-Filipino Abigail used in the thumbnail with permission from Airyn.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Aba's Universal Loves Begone
Manifest.Description: Resets Universal Love and/or Universal Like gift tastes back to vanilla or removes them entirely.
Manifest.Author: Abagaianye
